title: The Red-Black Pig
paragraphs: “We won’t lose either! Chorus Magic—‘Tornado!’”
Yuki-chan is using tornado magic to interfere with the vacuum-creating magic that Trash’s body double is casting.
“It’s okay, everyone! Ren, Itsuki, and Motoyasu-kun. For the sake of this country, for the people, we need to put an end to this situation immediately! Give it everything you’ve got!”
“Understood!”
“I’ll show you the true strength of fully matured heroes. You don’t need such unfair power or wasteful energy consumption to fight!”
“Power obtained by sacrificing innocent lives can never be justified. Saving only those who are convenient for you… that’s not what a true religion should be.”
Father has given his approval. My body has been getting sluggish lately, so this is the perfect opportunity.
I firmly grasp my spear and unleash my skills with full power!
“You impostors who blaspheme as gods! Take this—Brionac!”
“This isn’t over yet! ‘Eternal Arcane Blizzard!’”
The New Pope and Trash’s body double each unleashed their own attacks.
Brionac, huh?
Don’t go copying me! I’ll show you what real power looks like.
“Brionac X!”
“Meteor Sword X!”
“Gatling Blaster X!”

My spear shone brilliantly, transforming into a straight beam of light, effortlessly overpowering the New Pope’s Brionac. At the same time, Ren’s Meteor Sword’s radiance joined in. Itsuki’s barrage of bullets also combined with it, forming a torrent of light surging toward the New Pope and Trash’s body double.
“Hmph! Useless! Do you think an attack like that can reach us?”
“Fools… You fail to understand that we are under divine protection.”
A purple glow erupted from the ground, forming a barrier that protected Trash’s body double and the New Pope. That looks just like Father’s Meteor Wall—a massive defensive barrier has appeared.
It has strange markings… Is that an octagonal shield?
“That looks like something I’ve seen in an anime… A wall of the heart? No, no…”
Father casually responded.
But did they really think such a flimsy paper-like barrier could withstand our full power? In ten seconds, the wall had evaporated.
“Wha—Impossible—!”
“We have the protection of the gods—!”
“If you thought that level of power could defeat a hero, you were gravely mistaken!”
“Still, wasn’t their attack output pretty high? Naofumi’s shield took the biggest impact it ever has.”
“Yeah, if that had hit us directly, it would have been pretty bad.”
“The fact that we’d only call that ‘pretty bad’ is kind of crazy in itself…”

Just as Father made a remark, it happened almost simultaneously. The New Pope and Trash’s body double were sent flying by our skills. However, they managed to stay on their feet. They’re tougher than expected.
“Guh! This isn’t over yet—!”
The New Pope is trying to squeeze out more power from his copied weapon, attempting to counter with Brionac.
“I won’t lose—!”
Trash’s body double… what is he doing? He’s casting magic with a motion just like the projectile attack of a favorite character from a fighting game-loving pig.
“You sure try hard! Well then, let’s put in a little more strength!”
I pour in even more power, increasing the output. There’s no satisfaction if we don’t completely smash through the wall here.
“Got it. Itsuki, let’s add more power.”
“Yes!”
“I-Impossible! We who possess the power of the gods… losing…!?”
“Unbelievable! G-God…!”
Trash’s body double and the New Pope were blown away by our skills, turning into charred remains before vanishing completely. A fitting end for fools.
“Guaaaaaaaaah——…!”
With this, we’ve eliminated the obstacles. However, if we stop here, there’s no telling what else could happen.
“We continue the assault! Aiming Lancer X!”
“Hey! Motoyasu!”
Ignoring Ren’s protest, I skewer the remaining Three Hero Church members. If they survive, they’ll only cause more trouble later.
“Gyaaaaaaah—!”
“Ah, geez…”
In an instant, the battle was decided. Honestly, they weren’t that strong.
“Even after unleashing serious skills, it still took this much effort… I thought we could finish them off faster.”
“Weren’t they secretly pretty strong? That was an attack in our fully enhanced state.”
“You say that after taking them down in a single hit…?”
“No, no. These guys were absorbing power from that many people, remember? We were just too strong. Under normal circumstances, they would’ve been a huge threat.”
“Well… I guess that’s true.”
As we were having this conversation, the sound of clapping echoed through the room. We turned our eyes toward the red-black pig sitting on the throne.
Is it still alive? How odd. I should have taken it out amidst the chaos with Aiming Lancer.
Hmm? There’s something strange in the air. I can see the power that was residing in Trash’s body double and the New Pope converging into the red-black pig.
What is going on here? Father and the others are glaring at the red-black pig with grim expressions. The Queen steps forward, her brow furrowed.

“The ones who falsely posed as Aultcray, including the Pope, have already been dealt with by the Heroes. You were likely forced into that position, but that seat is rightfully mine… I would like to resolve this peacefully, so would you be willing to step down?”
“Bububu… Buhi.”
I feel like that was an incredibly infuriating response. The red-black pig let out a mocking laugh at us as it oinked in reply.
“Bubububu, Buhibuhi.”
Éclair grips her sword tightly, her glare unwavering. If the Queen gives the order, she will strike immediately. Of course, if Father gives the command, we will act without hesitation as well.
“We should have already defeated the mastermind, yet this phenomenon is still persisting… which means—”
Father stares at the red-black pig. Ren, Itsuki, our rivals, and even the Filolial are all on high alert. I, too, feel an ominous chill running down my spine.
“Bubu, Bubububu.”
“…I see. So, you’re saying that you were the true mastermind all along?”
“Bububububububuhi.”
I really have no idea what it’s saying. It’s getting annoying—I feel like blasting it away immediately.
“Father, what is it saying?”
“Ah… Well, when the Queen told it to step down, it refused. Then it mocked us, saying, ‘What are you so proud of? You’ve only beaten some weaklings.’”
What utter arrogance—beyond even that, it’s sheer ignorance of its own standing.

So this pig is related to the Queen…? Has its mind been completely consumed by the Three Hero Church? And to call even the Pope a weakling… Did it think that sitting on the throne for a short time made it powerful? This is why pigs never know their place.
“And then, it laughed and said, ‘It’s hilarious that you think you can take this country back. I can’t help but laugh—Ahahaha.’”
“Then, as if responding to Naofumi-san’s question, it said, ‘Yes, I am the center of the ritual. This entire nation exists solely to serve me…’”
What an arrogant fool. It may be slightly powerful, but its strength is nothing impressive. If we fought seriously, it wouldn’t even compare to the Spirit Tortoise.
“Bubu, Bububu.”
“W-What!?”

Father and the others were suddenly struck with expressions of shock. The Queen, Fiancée, and Éclair all looked equally stunned. I simply observed the scene calmly. The red-black pig had somehow produced a staff from nowhere and was making some sort of declaration.
“Motoyasu-kun!”
“What is it?”
“Look closely at the weapon that thing is holding!”
Following the command, I turned my gaze toward the staff in the red-black pig’s hand. At first glance, it looked like a scepter. …I feel like I’ve seen something with a similar presence before.

Was it Father’s? No, that’s not right. Father did have a staff once, but that one had a design resembling a wolf. However, just like my spear, this staff also had a magical orb embedded in it. Its overall shape was dark and carried an ominous aura.
“Earlier, that thing said it itself—the Seven Star Staff has chosen it and continues to grant it power.”
